description: This file defines interfaces related to type conversion and filtering in the Orleans.Serialization namespace, including ITypeConverter, ITypeNameFilter, and ITypeFilter.

classes.name: ITypeConverter
classes.description: Converts between Type and string representations.

classes.name: ITypeNameFilter
classes.description: Allows filtering of type names based on whether they are permitted to be loaded and serialized.

classes.name: ITypeFilter
classes.description: Determines if a given Type is allowed for serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: TryFormat
methods.description: Formats a Type as a string. Returns true if successful.

methods.name: TryParse
methods.description: Parses a string to produce a Type. Returns true if successful.

methods.name: IsTypeNameAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a type name and assembly name are permitted. Returns true, false, or null.

methods.name: IsTypeAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a Type is permitted. Returns true, false, or null.
